title: Count a reopened change as owned, not as in flight
context: The frozen spec (FR-1, AC-2) said a closed-then-reopened bundle is listed as in flight again. The in-flight list deliberately excludes any ever-closed bundle so no other session adopts it (earlier closed-bundle fix, INV-2). The build instead makes the session whose active pointer names the reopened bundle own it, which meets AC-1 and the Stop re-judgment without touching adoption.

options.label: Keep the narrow fix: only the reopening session owns it (recommended)
